\[
(f \oplus B) - f
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(f\): The image
- \(B\): The structuring element

It is 0 in flat areas and positive on the dark side of edges. Erosion takes the smallest value of f(p + z) for z in B. Dilation takes the largest value of f(p - z), which uses the element turned by 180 degrees. Both match the grayscale erosion and dilation of SciPy. On an image of 0 and 255 they are binary erosion and dilation.
